int k1 = 1;
struct Edge { int to, prev, flow; } edges[M];
int Dis[N][N];
struct Point { int x, y; } Q[100005];

inline int bfs()
{
    int i, p, l, r;
    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
    l = r = 1;
    dist[source] = 0;
    queue[1] = source;
    while (l <= r)
    {
        p = queue[l];
        for (i = head[p]; i; i = edges[i].prev)
            if (edges[i].flow > 0)
                if (dist[edges[i].to] == -1)
                {
                    queue[++r] = edges[i].to;
                    dist[edges[i].to] = dist[p] + 1;
                }
        l++;
    }
    return dist[sink] != -1;

void add_edge(int p1, int p2, int p3)

    edges[k1].flow = p3;
    edges[k1].prev = head[p1];

    edges[++k1].to = p1;
    edges[k1].flow = 0;
    edges[k1].prev = head[p2];
    head[p2] = k1;

        if (edges[i].flow > 0 && dist[edges[i].to] == dist[node] + 1)

                edges[i ^ 1].flow += a;

                total_flow += a;
